title: MLflow Documentation
description: Official documentation for MLflow, covering experiment tracking, model packaging and registry, evaluation, and deployment of machine learning models.
why_useful: Experiment tracking is the first MLOps habit worth forming, and MLflow can run locally, so the practice is learnable without any platform or budget.
learning_outcomes: Log parameters, metrics and artefacts for a run
Compare experiments and reproduce a past result
Package a model with its dependencies

title: Rules of Machine Learning
description: Guide to engineering practice for machine learning systems, organised as numbered rules covering when not to use ML, first pipelines, feature engineering, and long-term system health.
author: Martin Zinkevich
quality_notes: Written from experience at one large company; some advice assumes scale and infrastructure that a small team will not have.
why_useful: The rare document that says plainly when not to use machine learning at all, and treats the surrounding engineering as the hard part — which, in production, it is.
learning_outcomes: Decide whether a problem warrants machine learning
Sequence a first ML system sensibly
Anticipate the failure modes that appear only after launch
